_comment: FareBoost parser overrides. Every key is optional; anything absent, empty or malformed falls back to the value compiled into the app. Edits go live within 30 minutes, with no Play release and no reinstall.
_autoaccept_comment: A platform may run LIVE only once its audit log shows the tap landing correctly on real offers. Flip to true to graduate one - no rebuild needed. Lyft: proven 2026-07-19 plus a live tap on record. Uber: graduated 2026-07-24 - 8 clean shadow would-tap lines (Jul 21 shift, tight rect cluster ~[476,1146][572,1174]), canPerformGestures confirmed on device (capabilities=161, MotionEventInjector active); tap-time rails re-verify fare freshness and window geometry, so an unproven layout aborts instead of mis-tapping. Hopp: no audit entry of any kind - stays clamped. Cancel window is remotely tunable via autoaccept_cancel_window_ms (0-3000, driver chose 0 on 2026-07-24: race the bots; raise it here to restore a human pause without a rebuild).
_autoaccept_threshold_comment: Auto-accept ANY green (ACCEPT) offer at or above BOTH bars ($/hr and $/km), on top of goldens. Driver ask 2026-07-27. Both must be >0 or the feature is off. Only pays where the tap lands: Lyft click works; Uber tap is under test (node-click). Raise/lower here, no rebuild.
